description.en: Small pimples or bumps on face, chest, scalp, or back
description.fr: Petits boutons sur le visage, le torse, le cuir chevelu ou le dos
description.ar: حبوب أو بثور صغيرة على الوجه أو الصدر أو فروة الرأس أو الظهر

grading_criteria.1: Papules and/or pustules covering <10% BSA, which may or may not be associated with symptoms of pruritus or tenderness
grading_criteria.2: Papules and/or pustules covering 10–30% BSA, which may or may not be associated with symptoms of pruritus or tenderness; associated psychosocial impact; limiting instrumental ADL
grading_criteria.3: Papules and/or pustules covering >30% BSA, which may or may not be associated with pruritus or tenderness; limiting self-care ADL; associated local superinfection with oral antibiotics indicated
grading_criteria.4: Papules and/or pustules covering any % BSA, associated with extensive superinfection with IV antibiotics indicated; life-threatening consequences

label.ar: احمرار أو ألم في راحتي اليدين أو أخمصي القدمين

description.en: Redness, swelling, blistering, or pain on the palms of hands or soles of feet
description.fr: Rougeur, gonflement, cloques ou douleur sur la paume des mains ou la plante des pieds
description.ar: احمرار أو تورم أو بثور أو ألم في راحتي اليدين أو أخمصي القدمين

grading_criteria.1: Minimal skin changes or dermatitis (e.g., erythema, edema, or hyperkeratosis) without pain
grading_criteria.2: Skin changes (e.g., peeling, blisters, bleeding, edema, or hyperkeratosis) with pain; limiting instrumental ADL
grading_criteria.3: Severe skin changes (e.g., peeling, blisters, bleeding, edema, or hyperkeratosis) with pain; limiting self-care ADL

description.en: A rash that's spreading across the body — not in one spot
description.fr: Une éruption qui se propage sur le corps, pas à un seul endroit
description.ar: طفح جلدي ينتشر على الجسم وليس في مكان واحد فقط

grading_criteria.1: Macules/papules covering <10% BSA with or without symptoms (e.g., pruritus, burning, tightness)
grading_criteria.2: Macules/papules covering 10–30% BSA with or without symptoms; limiting instrumental ADL
grading_criteria.3: Macules/papules covering >30% BSA with or without associated symptoms; limiting self-care ADL
grading_criteria.4: Papules/pustules covering any % BSA; generalized exfoliative, erosive, or bullous dermatitis

label.fr: Réaction cutanée dans la zone d'irradiation
label.ar: تفاعل جلدي في منطقة العلاج الإشعاعي

description.en: Skin changes in the area where you received radiation therapy
description.fr: Changements de peau dans la zone où vous avez reçu la radiothérapie
description.ar: تغيرات في الجلد في المنطقة التي خضعت فيها للعلاج الإشعاعي

grading_criteria.2: Moderate to brisk erythema; patchy moist desquamation, mostly confined to skin folds and creases; moderate edema
grading_criteria.3: Moist desquamation in areas other than skin folds and creases; bleeding induced by minor trauma or abrasion
grading_criteria.4: Life-threatening consequences; skin necrosis or ulceration of full-thickness dermis; spontaneous bleeding from involved site

label.fr: Aphtes ou plaies dans la bouche

description.en: Painful sores, ulcers, or inflammation inside the mouth
description.fr: Plaies douloureuses, ulcères ou inflammation dans la bouche
description.ar: قرح مؤلمة أو تقرحات أو التهاب داخل الفم

grading_criteria.1: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated
grading_criteria.2: Moderate pain or ulcer; not interfering with oral intake; modified diet indicated
grading_criteria.3: Severe pain; interfering with oral intake

label.en: Not sure / let the AI decide
label.fr: Je ne suis pas sûr — laissez l'IA décider
label.ar: لست متأكداً — دعِ الذكاء الاصطناعي يقرر

description.fr: Téléchargez une photo et laissez le système identifier ce qu'il voit
